content.user_title: Design Data Asset Trust and Insurance Plans
content.value_statement: Organizations may struggle to isolate data asset rights and transfer related operational risks. This skill structures trust and insurance options with workflows, checks, and deliverables.
actual_capabilities: Compares self-benefit, third-party-benefit, and property-right trust structures for stated objectives.
Defines settlor, trustee, beneficiary, trust property, purpose, term, management, distributions, and exit terms.
Maps leakage, alteration, loss, infringement, and service errors to four relevant insurance categories.
Outlines trust and insurance workflows from initial diagnosis through administration or claims support.
Produces structured checklists for tax review, trustee engagement, underwriting materials, policy review, and ongoing reporting.
limitations: Does not replace advice from licensed lawyers, tax professionals, trustees, brokers, insurers, or regulators.
Cannot confirm current law, product availability, pricing, underwriting decisions, or registration requirements.
Cannot validate ownership, valuation, security controls, or loss estimates without reliable supporting evidence.
Provides planning materials only and cannot establish trusts, bind insurance, or guarantee financing outcomes.

use_cases.title: Assess Trust Feasibility
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether defined data asset rights fit a trust and identify legal, tax, registration, and trustee questions.

use_cases.title: Plan Insurance Coverage
use_cases.description: Map operational risks to cyber, data loss, professional liability, and infringement coverage options.

use_cases.title: Prepare Financing Support
use_cases.description: Document trust controls and insurance coverage for lender or transaction due diligence without promising approval.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Relevant Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this company profile: [profile]. List suitable trust and insurance options, key assumptions, and questions requiring professional advice.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Trust Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a preliminary trust structure for [objective]. Define each party, the specific data asset rights, governance, distributions, duration, and exit conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Insurance Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [risk register] and [loss estimates], propose coverage categories, limit methodology, deductibles, underwriting evidence, exclusions to review, and unresolved questions.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Integrated Execution Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Combine [trust goals], [rights evidence], [tax assumptions], and [risk data] into phased workflows, deliverables, review gates, responsibilities, and decision criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced trust and insurance program design

output_examples.input: A data services company wants operational separation and protection against client claims.
output: Trust review: define transferable operating and revenue rights before selecting a structure.
Insurance review: assess cyber, professional liability, and infringement coverage.
Required validation: legal ownership, tax treatment, loss estimates, exclusions, and trustee acceptance.

output_examples.input: Prepare a readiness checklist for a data asset trust discussion.
output: Document the trust purpose and jurisdiction.
Provide evidence for each proposed data asset right.
Identify settlor, licensed trustee, beneficiaries, duration, distributions, and exit terms.
Obtain legal and tax review before execution.

output_examples.input: Compare insurance needs for a data processor that has experienced no prior incidents.
output_examples.output: Review cyber and professional liability first, then assess data loss and infringement coverage. Use security controls and realistic loss scenarios to set limits.

best_practices: Provide jurisdiction, ownership evidence, asset rights, purpose, valuation, security controls, and financing context.
Separate confirmed facts, assumptions, open questions, and professional-review items in every deliverable.
Ask licensed specialists to validate legal, tax, trust, insurance, and regulatory conclusions before execution.
anti_patterns: Do not treat data itself as transferable trust property without defining the specific rights involved.
Do not promise bankruptcy isolation, coverage, claims payment, or financing approval.
Do not recommend policy limits or tax treatments from unsupported estimates.

faq.question: Can this skill establish a data asset trust?
faq.answer: No. It prepares planning materials, but a licensed trustee and qualified legal advisers must establish the trust.

faq.question: Does a trust guarantee bankruptcy isolation?
faq.answer: No. Effectiveness depends on jurisdiction, ownership, transfer validity, trust terms, timing, and professional legal review.

faq.question: Which rights can enter the trust?
faq.answer: The skill focuses on defined rights, such as operating, revenue, or holding rights. Eligibility requires evidence and jurisdiction-specific review.

faq.question: Which insurance categories does the skill consider?
faq.answer: It considers cyber, data asset loss, professional liability, and intellectual property or infringement coverage.

faq.question: Can it estimate premiums or guarantee coverage?
faq.answer: No. Insurers determine availability, terms, pricing, limits, exclusions, and underwriting decisions.

faq.question: What information improves the result?
faq.answer: Provide jurisdiction, objectives, ownership evidence, valuation, security controls, incident history, contracts, loss estimates, and financing requirements.
